He simply believed that somewhere a promise, once spoken, deserved an answer, even from a stranger on a lonely shore.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还没醒。路灯把空荡的马路照成淡黄色，红绿灯对着没有车的路口自顾自地换。早点铺的卷帘门拉开一半，热气先冒了出来。环卫车慢慢扫过街角，水痕在地面亮了一会儿又干。写字楼顶上还留着几扇没关的灯，不知道是加班的人，还是忘了关。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，尾灯一闪就拐进了巷子。天边有一点点发灰，鸟还没叫，城市像在换气，等着重新忙起来。", "w03": "- Imagine standing between two mirrors so you see yourself inside yourself, again and again, getting smaller each time.\n- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It has to know when to stop, like counting down to zero, or it would keep calling itself forever."}
